title: SignalVariety
description: What a flow atom REVEALS about the context it was emitted from, independent of its EprKind. The policy-addressable taxonomy for aggregation lanes: adoption-time policy contracts declare, per variety, whether and how signals aggregate upward from private contexts. Design home: genesis/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-31-care-aggregation-adoption-policy-floor-design.md (care-aggregation-adoption-policy-floor-design §3).

core.rationale: One atom may carry several varieties; the taxonomy exists so lane policy can address each disclosure class separately. completion-count = the fact of completion; engagement-duration = how long; timing-pattern = when (the variety that leaks household rhythm); sequence-trace = in what order; content-response = answer/free-text payloads; presence-coincidence = who was together. Closed set by design — a variety no policy can name is a variety no lane can suppress.
